definitions.explanation: The counter reading for two of something flat: sheets of paper, tickets, plates, photos, or garments.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二枚|にまい}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二枚|にまい}⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Two sheets of paper are left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}かった→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二枚|にまい}⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I layered two shirts and went out.

notes:
{二枚|にまい} is the reading for "two" with the counter ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧, used for thin, flat things.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二枚|にまい}⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to layer two of something
- {二枚|にまい}{組|ぐみ}: a two-disc or two-sheet set
- {二枚|にまい}おろし: filleting a fish into two pieces

RELATED WORDS:
{二枚目|にまいめ} means "a good-looking man," from the second billboard in an Edo-period theater lineup. It is not simply "the second flat object."

RELATED COUNTERS:
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: one flat object
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧: how many flat objects
